_note: AETHER Tool Store catalog — vetted extra security tools from Debian's own repos, not preinstalled (zero bloat: add what you need). Edit freely.

tools.name: Gobuster
tools.desc: Brute-force directories, DNS subdomains, and vhosts. Fast, written in Go.

tools.name: ffuf
tools.desc: Fast web fuzzer for directories, parameters, and virtual hosts.

tools.name: dirb
tools.desc: Classic web content scanner using a wordlist of common paths.

tools.name: Wfuzz
tools.desc: Fuzz any part of an HTTP request to find hidden content and bugs.

tools.name: WhatWeb
tools.desc: Fingerprint a website: CMS, frameworks, servers, and versions.

tools.name: Wapiti
tools.desc: Black-box web app vulnerability scanner (XSS, SQLi, and more).

tools.name: masscan
tools.desc: Internet-scale port scanner — extremely fast, asynchronous.

tools.name: hping3
tools.desc: Craft custom TCP/IP packets for scanning, testing, and tracerouting.

tools.name: netcat (OpenBSD)
tools.desc: The TCP/UDP swiss-army knife: connect, listen, transfer, debug.

tools.name: socat
tools.desc: Multipurpose relay: sockets, pipes, TLS, port-forwarding.

tools.name: proxychains-ng
tools.desc: Force any tool's traffic through a proxy chain (e.g. over Tor).

tools.name: dig / DNS utils
tools.desc: dig, nslookup, and friends for DNS reconnaissance.

tools.name: whois
tools.desc: Look up domain and IP registration details.

tools.name: nbtscan
tools.desc: Scan networks for NetBIOS name information.

tools.name: enum4linux
tools.desc: Enumerate information from Windows and Samba systems.

tools.name: hashcat
tools.desc: Advanced password recovery across many hash types.

tools.name: macchanger
tools.desc: View and change a network interface's MAC address.
